name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: Audits a website for AI-discoverability and on-site-engagement problems and emits one prioritised, evidence-backed audit report.

skills.description: Entrypoint. Composes every other skill, applies the reach-read-extract-trust gate cascade, dedupes, scores, and emits the single audit report.
Fetches and renders the site exactly once and writes the shared evidence bundle. The only skill that touches the network.
Detects site archetype and per-page type, then selects the threshold profile every other skill scores against.
Stage reach. Determines whether an AI crawler is allowed in at all: robots.txt, edge blocking, indexability, link integrity.
Stage read. Determines whether the page is readable without executing JavaScript, and whether facts are locked in non-text.
Stage extract. Determines whether the page's facts are machine-typed via JSON-LD, microdata, or RDFa.
Stage extract. Determines whether a specific fact can be lifted out of the page and quoted on its own.
Stage trust. Determines whether a machine would believe the page: date coherence, entity identity, external corroboration.
Stage act. Determines whether a visitor who arrives can orient, act, and continue.
